summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The SEI Select Small Cap ETF (SEIS) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in small-cap stocks. The fund is actively managed, seeking capital appreciation through investments in small-cap US stocks. The selection process integrates the advisers proprietary quantitative model with recommendations from one or more sub-advisers. SEIS was launched on Jul 31, 2024 and is issued by SEI.

holdings.infoBox: SEIS is an equity ETF with a total of 370 individual holdings. The top holdings are CNO Financial Group stock at 1.29%, Abercrombie & Fitch Co. at 1.23%, Terex at 1.11%, Watts Water Technologies at 1.06%, and Urban Outfitters at 1.04%.
